page.layout: One printed title page, one block of text centred at the top, a woodcut device in the middle, and the imprint below it. No margin notes. A manuscript shelf mark in the upper right corner is not transcribed.

main_text.l: illius quæ signa ex pulsibus & vrinis
OPVS Omnibus rem medicam exercentibus vti-

page.notes: The woodcut device between the title lines and the imprint shows a shield with a cross and a letter G, flanked by a scroll and foliage, with the motto ribbon partly legible as "SSNE". Its letters are too worn to copy. The first line "ENCHIRIDION" is letterspaced in italic capitals. Numerals "1.", "2.", "3." are set in a larger italic style. The imprint date reads MDLXXXI, printed as M. D. LXXXI.
